cases.name: Gather the Pack
cases.text:
Reveal the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, put up to two creature cards from among the revealed cards into your hand instead of one.
